cites.quote: runs inside the API process on a timer every hour

findings.suggested_fix: State in CO-5 that each run catches and logs errors so the API keeps serving, and whether a first run happens at startup.
findings.text: The in-process hourly job does not say how a failed run is handled (caught and logged vs unhandled rejection in the API process) or whether it runs once at startup.

cites.quote: request accepted when the current status is SCHEDULED or STALE; response status COMPLETED

findings.suggested_fix: Describe the response status field alone and state the precondition (409 otherwise) as a rule of the endpoint.
findings.text: EP-3 to EP-6 list a single 'status' field whose format mixes the request precondition with the response value; the routes take no status in the request.

cites.quote: 'system' for an event the job writes

findings.suggested_fix: Format: 'staff' for staff actions, 'system' for the Stale job.
findings.text: history[].actor format names only 'system' for job events; it does not state the existing value 'staff' for staff actions, so the field's full value set is not given.

findings.suggested_fix: Add context/generated/db-schema.json with its sha256 to inputs.
findings.text: C10 and EP-1/EP-2 cite context/generated/db-schema.json, which is not listed among the artifact's inputs.

rubric_items.reason: Built on the existing layers: migration in db, repo/service/server changes in api, label/badge/page changes in web; the in-process job adds no infrastructure, as asked in A-08.
S-1 to S-5 and S-7 are fully mapped to components and endpoints; S-6 is served only by a component outside the diff (CO-12), left to the glossary owner per A-11.
Every changed field has name, type, nullability, format and example; EP-3..EP-6 mix the request precondition into a response 'status' field and history[].actor names only 'system'.

Choices are cited or decided by IDE answers and CO-1 is Assumed with implement must confirm; CO-12 is labelled existing on the product root module though the glossary entry is new and lives in the context pack.
Trade-offs given for the in-process timer with several instances and for Stale rows freeing their slot; no reason given for job failure handling or a run at startup.
Clear overview, consistent ids between front matter and body, and an explicit story-to-component map.
